name: Cheetah ADSL
summary: ADSL broadband brand of Ozzieweb (2001); dead c.2002 (reduced to a static splash page thereafter).

events.details: 'ADSL Cheetah Broadband in Australia... Cheetah (TM) Broadband connection by Ozzieweb'; substantive product homepage captured Jun 2001.

Product content only seen in 2001; from Jan 2002 cheetah.net.au served just a bare 'Cheetah - simply the fastest' splash that persisted unchanged 2002-2013 (503 errors from 2015), so the retail brand was effectively gone by ~2002.
